battle.name: 梁晉爭霸
battle.brief: 開平四年（910）十月起，晉王李存勖與後梁為爭河朔在趙州、柏鄉一線開戰，野河之役晉軍殲梁兵二萬餘，梁軍退回漳河南岸，河北門戶洞開。卡面羅馬短劍未入中土，其持盾掩護、以刺突收官的近戰邏輯，近於唐末藩鎮步卒以大盾配橫刀抵騎鋒的做法。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 梁晉爭霸是唐末至五代前期，後梁與河東晉軍為爭奪黃河下游與河朔地區而進行的十三年對抗，起於開平四年（910），至同光元年（923）後梁覆亡為止。交戰一方是朱溫建立的後梁：都汴州，憑宣武軍的底子控制河南，掙扎著兼併河北各鎮；麾下是數十萬眾，既有北衙禁軍與節度使的藩鎮兵，也有直屬朱溫的義子軍與死士，糧道倚重汴州至大梁一線的漕運與河南州的屯田。另一方是河東的晉軍：沙陀李克用系，晉陽為根本，李克用以控弦騎兵名世；晉軍十餘萬，以騎兵為核心，步卒輔以河東久處戰陣的老兵與防蕃、防契丹的前線將校。指揮系統上，梁以朱溫為最高統帥，重大決策出自汴州；朱溫死後由朱友貞坐鎮，遠在河北的劉鄩、段凝各自領兵，號令常不能相一。晉以晉王李存勖總督，底下是周德威、李嗣源、李存孝、安重榮等宿將，河東與魏州、趙州的外線將領也歸其節制。第三方是北方的契丹，耶律阿保機於917年乘隙攻幽州；南方則有吳、蜀、荊南等割據者，梁吳之間曾有交涉。地理上，爭霸的主軸是黃河下游數百里的平原與渡口：楊劉、德勝是北軍南下的踏板，魏州是總集結地，鎮州、趙州、深州、冀州、邢州、洺州是拉鋸的地盤，潞州與幽州則是北翼的支點。
countriesEn: The Liang–Jin struggle was a thirteen-year contest fought from the end of the Tang through the early Five Dynasties between the Later Liang and the Jin army of Hedong for the right to rule the lower Yellow River and the lands of Hebei. It began in 910 and ended with the destruction of the Later Liang in 923. One party was the Later Liang founded by Zhu Wen. Capitaled at Bianzhou, it stood on the base of the Xuanwu Army and held Henan, and it strove to swallow up the circuits of Hebei; its forces numbered in the tens and hundreds of thousands, and combined the guards of the central camps and the circuit armies of the regional governors with the corps of “adopted sons” and the “death warriors” kept directly under Zhu Wen, while its supply rested on the river transport and the garrison farms of Henan. The other party was the Jin army of Hedong: the Shatuo house of Li Keyong, rooted in Taiyuan, the Li clan's mounted archers renowned beyond all, an army of more than a hundred thousand with cavalry at its core, its foot soldiers reinforced by the long-settled troops of Hedong and by the officers who had held the Tibetan and Khitan frontiers. As for command, the supreme commander of the Liang was Zhu Wen, and the great decisions were taken at Bian; after his death Zhu Youzhen held the centre, while commanders far away in Hebei such as Liu Cun and Duan Ning led armies of their own and the orders of the capital often failed to reach them. The Jin were commanded by the Prince of Jin, Li Cunxu, with such veterans as Zhou Dewei, Li Siyuan, Li Cunxiao and An Chongrong under him, and the outlying commanders at Weizhou and Zhaozhou also under his orders. A third party was the Khitan to the north, whose emperor Yelü Abaoji struck at Youzhou in 917; to the south stood Wu, Shu and Jingnan, and the Liang exchanged envoys with Wu. Geographically the axis of the contest was the several hundred li of plain and river crossings below the Yellow River: Yangliu and Desheng were the stepping stones for a northern army marching south, Weizhou was the place of assembly, Zhenzhou, Zhaozhou, Shenzhou, Jizhou, Xingzhou and Mingzhou were the ground on which the war swung back and forth, and Luzhou and Youzhou were the pivots of the northern flank.
people: 梁晉爭霸的關鍵人物分屬兩家，另有幾個外部變數在推動時局。後梁方面，朱溫是整場爭霸的起點：他在唐末掃平關中與河南，904年逼唐昭宗遷都後弒之，907年四月迫唐哀帝禪位，建立後梁；他不僅要削平河東，更要吞掉河朔三鎮，910年以「助王鎔抗劉守光」為名率軍深入深州、冀州，暴露了兼併的意圖；晚年他進退失據，912年被其次子朱友珪弒殺。朱友珪即位後又為其弟朱友貞所弒，梁末帝朱友貞在位十年，是後梁覆亡時的君主。梁軍的將領有兩位特別關鍵：一是劉鄩，梁末帝任命的開封尹，915年楊師厚病逝後率六萬兵接管魏博，916年在魏州被李存勖包圍，全軍覆沒，僅以數十騎脫身；二是王彥章，號「鐵槍」，都虞候出身，善使槊、能挽重弓，梁末帝倚為柱石，923年中都之戰中率軍迎戰唐軍，兵敗被俘，堅拒不降，終被斬於市。晉軍方面，李克用是沙陀軍的建立者，討黃巢而成名，受封晉王，割據河東，908年病逝；其子李存勖嗣位晉王，領兵打完全部關鍵戰役，柏鄉野河之役破梁軍，916年魏州之戰全殲劉鄩，918年集軍十萬於魏州南下，923年在魏州稱帝為後唐莊宗，同年滅梁。宿將之中周德威最能打，他率晉軍主力屢次出戰，是柏鄉、魏州、幽州各役的指揮者；李嗣源出身振武軍騎卒，是莊宗最倚重的騎將，923年率前鋒夜渡汶水，攻中都、擒王彥章，率先兵臨汴城。降將康延孝出身唐末牙兵，後為梁軍將領，923年八月向莊宗告發梁軍北進計畫，成為最後一役的鑰匙；北面招討使段凝率五萬梁軍，聞汴城失守才回援，於封丘解甲請降。此外還有決定河北存亡者：成德軍節度使王鎔、義成軍節度使王處直相繼向晉求救；幽州盧龍節度使劉守光於911年稱帝建燕，兩年後被晉所滅；契丹皇帝耶律阿保機則在917年大軍壓幽州，迫使晉軍回師北上。
peopleEn: The decisive figures of the Liang–Jin struggle belonged to the two houses, with a few outside variables pushing events along. On the Liang side, Zhu Wen was the starting point of the whole contest: in the late Tang he swept through Guanzhong and Henan, in 904 he forced the Tang emperor Zhaozong to move the capital and then killed him, and in the fourth month of 907 he compelled the Tang emperor Ai to abdicate and founded the Later Liang. He wanted not only to destroy Hedong but to swallow the three circuits of Hebei, and in 910 he marched deep into Shenzhou and Jizhou under the pretext of helping Wang Rong against Liu Shouguang, which laid his design bare. Late in life he lost his grip, and in 912 his second son Zhu Yougui murdered him. Zhu Yougui was then murdered in his turn by his younger brother Zhu Youzhen, who ruled as the last Liang emperor for ten years and was on the throne when the dynasty fell. Two Liang commanders mattered especially. The first was Liu Cun, appointed governor of the capital by the last emperor, who took sixty thousand men to take over Weibo in 915 after the death of Yang Shihou; in 916 Li Cunxu closed around him at the old Yuan city and destroyed his whole army, and he escaped with only a few dozen riders. The second was Wang Yanzhang, known as the “iron spear”, a former duhou officer, skilled with the long spear and able to draw a heavy bow, on whom the last Liang emperor relied as a pillar; he met the Tang army in battle at Zhongdu in 923, was taken prisoner, refused to submit, and was beheaded in the market. On the Jin side, Li Keyong had built the Shatuo army, earned his fame by suppressing Huang Chao, was made Prince of Jin, and established himself in Hedong; he died of illness in 908. His son Li Cunxu succeeded him as Prince of Jin and fought every decisive action himself: he broke the Liang army at the Yehe river near Baixiang, destroyed the army of Liu Cun at Weizhou in 916, mustered a hundred thousand men at Weizhou in 918 to march south, and in 923 proclaimed himself emperor at Weizhou as the Later Tang Zhuangzong, bringing down the Liang in the same year. Of the veterans, Zhou Dewei was the ablest soldier, leading the main body of the Jin host in the campaigns of Baixiang, Weizhou and Youzhou. Li Siyuan, a trooper out of the Zhenwu Army, was the mounted commander the Zhuangzong trusted most; in 923 he led the vanguard across the Wenshui by night, took Zhongdu, captured Wang Yanzhang, and was the first of the army before Bian. The turncoat Kang Yanxiao, once a tooth soldier of the late Tang and later a Liang officer, came over in the eighth month of 923 and reported the Liang plan for a northern advance, and became the key to the last battle; Duan Ning, the Liang commander in the north, led fifty thousand men and only turned back when Bian had already fallen, and at Fengqiu he asked to surrender with his armour off. Two more men were decisive for the fate of Hebei: Wang Rong, military governor of the Chengde Army, and Wang Chuzhi, of the Yicheng Army, who one after another appealed to the Jin for help. Liu Shouguang, military governor of Lulong at Youzhou, proclaimed himself emperor of Yan in 911 and was destroyed by the Jin two years later. And the Khitan emperor Yelü Abaoji pressed on Youzhou with a great army in 917, forcing the Jin to turn back north.
kits: 卡面這柄羅馬短劍並不屬於開平年間任何一方的裝備序列。公元910年的羅馬帝國已是東羅馬的拜占庭國家，時值利奧六世在位，帝國以禁衛軍與軍區制為骨幹，共和末期那套制式軍團早已不復存在，劍兵也已改用長身劍（spatha）與各式雙刃長劍；梁晉爭霸同歐洲沒有任何直接關係，它在此處的作用是提供一個技術坐標。羅馬短劍本身是共和末期至帝國前期軍團步兵的制式短刺劍：刃長約六十公分，單刃或雙刃，刃形如葉，柄端有圓盤狀柄頭，沒有護手，重心靠前，幾乎不用來揮砍；它只出現在兩種場合，盾後的短距刺擊，以及盾牆與盾牆之間的縫隙突刺。與它配套的是一人多高的曲面大盾（scutum）、鎖子甲、頭盔與百夫長制，一刺得手便退回盾後重新列隊。河東與中原走的是另一條路：晉軍以沙陀騎兵為核心，配彎弓、標槍、馬槊與環首刀，騎士多不著甲，靠控弦的節奏與衝鋒的突然取勝；朱溫的宣武軍在河南募練禁軍與「死士」，步卒用橫刀（唐人稱儀刀、佩刀）配大盾與拒馬，另有陌刀一類雙刃長刀供重裝步卒砍劈，弩是遠射手的主力，蹶張弩與臂弩之外，《通典》兵工所載的「神機弩」是唐人已知的連發弩機，一次可發多矢。攻城有雲梯、飛樓、拋車與衝車，野戰的決定裝備則是馬匹、糧車與浮橋渡口。還要說明的是，劍在唐末五代已退居儀仗與操練，戰陣上真正通用的是刀；因此羅馬短劍在這場戰爭裡的位置是一面鏡子：它標示出同一時代歐亞另一端那種「不揮砍、以刺突與盾緣定勝負」的短兵邏輯，而梁晉爭霸真正靠以取勝的，是騎兵機動、河東的糧源與渡口的控制。
kitsEn: The gladius on the card belongs to no equipment inventory of the Kaitai era. In AD 910 the Roman empire was already the Eastern Roman state, a Byzantine empire: the emperor was Leo VI, the army rested on the palace guard and the theme system, and the standard legions of the late Republic had long ceased to exist, the sword troops having taken up the long spatha and the various double-edged longswords. The Liang–Jin struggle had nothing to do with Europe, and the function of the weapon here is to supply a technical coordinate. The gladius itself was the standard short stabbing sword of the legionary infantry from the late Republic into the early Empire: the blade about sixty centimetres, single or double edged, leaf-shaped, with a disc pommel at the hilt, no handguard, the weight carried forward, and almost never swung. It appeared in only two situations, the short thrust from behind a shield, and the sudden stab into the gap between two shields. It went with a tall curved shield (scutum), a mail shirt, a helmet and the century system, and after one thrust the swordsman fell back behind his shield and re-formed the line. The armament of Hedong and of the central plain ran down a different road. The Jin host had cavalry at its core, with composite bows, javelins, the long spear and the ring-pommel sabre; the riders were mostly unarmoured, and victory came from the rhythm of the drawn bow and from the suddenness of the charge. The Xuanwu Army of Zhu Wen recruited guards and “death warriors” in Henan; its foot soldiers carried the hengdao, known to the Tang as the yidao and the peidao, together with large shields and juma, the bristling obstacles set against horses, while the modao, a two-edged long blade, was for armoured infantry to chop with. The crossbow was the main arm at range; besides the drawn bow and the arm bow there was the shenji crossbow noted in the chapter on military engineering in the Tang encyclopaedia Tongdian, a repeating weapon that could loose several bolts at once. For siege there were scaling ladders, flying towers, trebuchets and battering rams, and the decisive equipment in the field was the horse, the grain wagon and the pontoon crossings. One more point should be made: by the late Tang and the Five Dynasties the sword had fallen back to parade ground and drill, and the blade actually in general use was the sabre. The gladius therefore stands in this war as a mirror, marking the short-weapon logic of the other end of Eurasia in the same age, in which nothing was swung and the issue was settled by the thrust and the rim of the shield, whereas what decided the Liang–Jin struggle was cavalry movement, the grain of Hedong and control of the crossings.
tactics: 梁晉爭霸的戰術，隨爭霸的階段而變。柏鄉之戰前，梁軍的戰略意圖是用「師出有名」的援助把軍隊開進河朔，先取王鎔的成德軍與王處直的義成軍，把河北諸鎮納入宣武軍的編制；晉軍的反應是先出井陘、屯兵趙州，把河北的門戶卡在晉陽與趙州之間，再南下切斷梁軍與河北的聯繫。柏鄉野河之戰，晉軍以步兵結方陣承受梁軍的騎兵衝擊，等到梁軍攻勢已疲，周德威率的精騎才斜著衝擊梁軍陣腳的兩側；梁軍失去河北門戶，漳河以北只剩邢州、洺州兩處。幽州與燕國的戰役裡，晉軍用圍城與野戰配合，逐次消滅劉守光的軍力；契丹在917年南下攻幽州，晉軍被迫回師北向，形成前線與後方同時吃緊的窘境。魏州之戰是攻守之勢的翻轉：劉鄩率六萬兵接管魏博，魏州兵變，梁軍指揮系統出現裂縫，晉軍主力長驅而來，把梁軍包圍在故元城一帶全殲。夾河之陣則是一場對峙消耗戰：918年八月李存勖在魏州集軍十萬欲南渡攻汴，梁軍據濮州堅守不戰，兩軍對峙一百多天，激戰之後雙方都損失了三分之二的兵力。最後一役是全場最漂亮的奇襲：923年九月康延孝來降報信，十月初二莊宗自楊劉渡黃河，初三抵鄆州，李嗣源當夜渡汶水，初四清晨在中都與王彥章大軍相遇，李存勖親率大軍隨後而至；初七曹州降，初九汴州下，十二日段凝的五萬主力在封丘解甲。一路的要訣是目標明確、晝夜兼程、以騎兵奔襲直取國都，而不是啃骨頭式的攻城。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the Liang–Jin struggle changed with its phases. Before the battle of Baixiang the Liang plan was to use a legitimate relief mission to move troops into the lands of Hebei, take first the Chengde Army of Wang Rong and the Yicheng Army of Wang Chuzhi, and fold the circuits of Hebei into the Xuanwu system; the Jin answered by sending a column out through Jingxing to hold Zhaozhou, shutting the door of Hebei between Jinyang and Zhaozhou, and then striking south to cut the Liang army off from Hebei. At the Yehe river the Jin formed their foot into a square to receive the Liang cavalry charge, and only when the Liang attack had spent itself did the picked horse led by Zhou Dewei drive obliquely into both flanks of the Liang line; the Liang lost the door of Hebei, and north of the Zhang River only Xingzhou and Mingzhou were left. In the fighting over Youzhou and the state of Yan the Jin combined investment with manoeuvre in the open field and destroyed the strength of Liu Shouguang piece by piece; when the Khitan struck at Youzhou in 917 the Jin had to turn back north, leaving them pinned between the front and the rear. The battle of Weizhou reversed the sense of attack and defence: Liu Cun took sixty thousand men to take over Weibo, the soldiers of Weizhou mutinied, a crack opened in the Liang command structure, and the main Jin host came up at a long march and enclosed the Liang army near the old Yuan city, destroying it. The Jiahe array was a war of attrition: in the eighth month of 918 Li Cunxu mustered a hundred thousand men at Weizhou to cross the river and strike Bian, and the Liang held at Puzhou and refused to give battle; the two armies faced one another for more than a hundred days, and after the engagement both had lost two thirds of their strength. The last action was the most elegant surprise of the war: in the ninth month of 923 the turncoat Kang Yanxiao came in with the news, the Zhuangzong crossed the Yellow River at Yangliu on the second day of the tenth month and reached Yunzhou on the third, Li Siyuan crossed the Wenshui that same night, at dawn on the fourth they met the army of Wang Yanzhang at Zhongdu, and Li Cunxu followed with the main body; Cao surrendered on the seventh, Bian fell on the ninth, and on the twelfth the fifty thousand men of Duan Ning laid down their arms at Fengqiu. The lesson of that march is a clear objective, marching day and night, a cavalry dash straight at the capital, and no grinding siege of a walled town.
data: 可核對的數字集中在年表與兵力兩端。年表是：907年四月朱全忠迫唐哀帝禪位建梁；908年李克用病死，李存勖嗣晉王；910年十月至911年正月，晉梁在柏鄉北野河一線大戰；911年八月劉守光稱帝建燕；912年朱溫被朱友珪所殺，913年朱友貞即位；915年三月宣義軍節度使楊師厚病死，劉鄩將六萬兵入魏博，魏州兵變；916年二月魏州（故元城）之戰，劉鄩部七萬覆滅；917年晉軍擊退契丹於幽州；918年八月李存勖在魏州集軍十萬南下，與梁軍在夾河對峙一百多天；923年四月李存勖在魏州稱帝建後唐；同光元年十月初二渡楊劉，初四克中都俘王彥章，初七曹州降，初九汴州下，十二日段凝率五萬降於封丘。兵力上，後梁盛時掌控中原與關東，兵至數十萬；晉軍十餘萬，以沙陀騎兵為核心。柏鄉之戰晉軍殲滅梁軍二萬餘，河北只剩邢州、洺州；魏州之戰滅梁軍七萬；918年晉軍集兵十萬；劉守光曾以二萬兵攻容城，晉軍以三萬應之；末了那名北面招討使段凝麾下有五萬主力。損失上最刺目的數字是夾河對峙之後雙方各折三分之二兵力。速度上，923年十月初二渡黃河到初九兵臨汴梁，旬日之間自楊劉打到國都城下。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked sit at the two ends of the record, the chronology and the strengths. The chronology runs: in the fourth month of 907 Zhu Quanzhong compelled the Tang emperor Ai to abdicate and founded the Liang; in 908 Li Keyong died of illness and Li Cunxu succeeded as Prince of Jin; from the tenth month of 910 to the first month of 911 the two sides fought in the open country around the Yehe river north of Baixiang; in the eighth month of 911 Liu Shouguang proclaimed himself emperor of Yan; in 912 Zhu Wen was killed by Zhu Yougui, and in 913 Zhu Youzhen took the throne; in the third month of 915 Yang Shihou, military governor of Xuanyi, died of illness, Liu Cun took sixty thousand men into Weibo, and the soldiers of Weizhou mutinied; in the second month of 916 the battle of Weizhou at the old Yuan city destroyed the seventy thousand Liang troops of Liu Cun; in 917 the Jin drove the Khitan off at Youzhou; in the eighth month of 918 Li Cunxu mustered a hundred thousand men at Weizhou and marched south, facing the Liang across the Jiahe for more than a hundred days; in the fourth month of 923 he proclaimed himself emperor at Weizhou and founded the Later Tang; in the first year of Tongguang, on the second day of the tenth month the army crossed at Yangliu, on the fourth it took Zhongdu and captured Wang Yanzhang, on the seventh Cao surrendered, on the ninth Bian fell, and on the twelfth Duan Ning surrendered with fifty thousand men at Fengqiu. On strength, the Later Liang at its height held the central plain and the lands east of the passes with forces in the tens and hundreds of thousands, while the Jin had more than a hundred thousand men with the Shatuo cavalry at the core. The battle of Baixiang destroyed more than twenty thousand Liang troops, leaving only Xingzhou and Mingzhou north of the Zhang River; the battle of Weizhou destroyed seventy thousand Liang men; a hundred thousand Jin troops were assembled in 918; Liu Shouguang once sent twenty thousand men against Rongcheng and the Jin answered with thirty thousand; and the northern commander Duan Ning had fifty thousand men under him at the end. The most striking figure for losses is that after the Jiahe stalemate each side had lost two thirds of its strength. On speed, the crossing of the river on the second day of the tenth month and the appearance of the army before Bian on the ninth meant that the march from Yangliu to the walls of the capital took no more than eight days.
cause: 打起來的根子，是唐末的藩鎮格局在朱溫手裡收窄成只容得下兩家的局面。朱溫先掃平河南關中，904年弒唐昭宗，907年逼唐哀帝禪位，建立後梁；此後中原只餘兩股最大的力量：汴州的朱梁與河東的晉。晉王李克用因平黃巢之亂而受封晉王，據河東自成一體，朱溫視之為最硬的障礙，李克用亦不臣於梁，雙方在河內、昭義一線長期摩擦，李存勖接位後更在潞州之戰中取勝，晉的勢力自此壓到上黨。第二層是河北。河朔三鎮成德軍、義成軍、盧龍軍長期保持半獨立，朱溫要獨霸中原，就必須把河北併入宣武軍的系統；910年他以援助王鎔抵抗劉守光為名，率軍直抵深州、冀州，兵鋒已抵鎮州城下，這一舉動讓王鎔看清了梁的意圖，他轉向李存勖求援，晉軍於是出井陘、屯趙州，柏鄉之戰就此爆發；其後劉守光在911年稱帝建燕，河朔一時三個政權並立，晉軍趁勢滅燕，河北的門戶便再也沒有守住。第三層是梁廷內部的裂痕與河南的資源上限。劉鄩奉命以六萬兵接管魏博，本身就說明梁廷已無力同時控制中原與河北；魏州兵變之後，魏博的兵馬人心轉到晉手，河北門戶洞開，兩家的差距就再也拉不回來。第四層是契丹這個北方變數，917年大軍壓幽州，晉軍只能回師，說明任何一方都無法承受兩線作戰。最後是戰爭本身的目標：誰能把河東、河北與中原連成一體，誰就取得天下，這使雙方都不可能在任何一線上長期妥協。
causeEn: The root of the fighting lies in the way the circuit system of the late Tang, in Zhu Wen's hands, narrowed down until only two houses could fit inside it. Zhu Wen first swept Henan and Guanzhong, killed the Tang emperor Zhaozong in 904, forced the Tang emperor Ai to abdicate in 907 and founded the Later Liang; from then on the central plain held only two great powers, the Zhu Liang at Bian and the Jin in Hedong. The Prince of Jin, Li Keyong, had been made Prince of Jin for his part in suppressing Huang Chao, and his independent state in Hedong was the hardest obstacle for Zhu Wen, who in turn would not serve the Liang. The two rubbed against one another along the Henei and Zhaoyi lines, and when Li Cunxu took over he won the war at Luzhou, pressing the Jin's strength up to Shangdang. The second layer was Hebei. The three circuits of Hebei, the Chengde Army, the Yicheng Army and Lulong, had long kept a half independence, and for Zhu Wen to be sole master of the central plain the circuits of Hebei had to be folded into the Xuanwu system; in 910 he marched straight to Shenzhou and Jizhou under the pretext of helping Wang Rong resist Liu Shouguang, his advanced guard reaching the walls of Zhenzhou, and that move showed Wang Rong the Liang design plain, so he turned to Li Cunxu for help; the Jin sent troops out through Jingxing to hold Zhaozhou, and the battle of Baixiang followed. Later, when Liu Shouguang proclaimed himself emperor of Yan in 911, three regimes stood at once in Hebei, and the Jin destroyed Yan and took the southern gate of Hebei for good. The third layer was the fissure inside the Liang court and the ceiling on the resources of Henan. Sending Liu Cun with sixty thousand men to take over Weibo showed that the Liang court could no longer hold the central plain and Hebei at the same time; after the mutiny of Weizhou the troops and the people of Weibo went over to the Jin, the southern gate of Hebei stood open, and the gap between the two houses could never be closed again. The fourth layer was the northern variable, the Khitan, whose great army pressed on Youzhou in 917 and forced the Jin to turn back, showing that neither side could fight on two fronts at once. At the bottom lay the object of the war itself: whoever could join Hedong, Hebei and the central plain into one would have the empire, and that left neither side able to make a lasting compromise on any single front.
impact: 梁晉爭霸的結果，長遠看有三層。第一層是中原正統的轉移：後唐以沙陀軍事集團接管中原，五代此後的後晉（石敬瑭，沙陀）、後漢（劉知遠，沙陀）、後周（郭威，邢州軍）連續三個中原王朝都出自北方的軍鎮與胡族背景，五代一以貫之的「河東—河北—中原」軸線，源頭就在這十三年。河北的歸屬是第二層：魏博歸晉之後，河朔三鎮再沒有出現能與中央抗爭的獨立強人；五代中期後周世宗顯德年間一度收復幽州、瀛州等地，那也只是收復失地，真正把燕雲十六州握在中原手中，要等到後唐末與石敬瑭936年割地契丹之前那段短暫的窗口。923年滅燕、幽州歸晉的做法，把河北的鑰匙交到中原王朝手裡，卻沒有解決契丹本身，契丹反而佔了便宜：到936年割讓燕雲十六州時，中原在北方已無任何屏障。第三層是戰爭技術的成熟：這十三年把騎兵機動、河東的糧源、渡口的控制與情報的作用推到頂點，最後一役靠一名降將的情報與八日的奔襲決定天下，正是唐末藩鎮混戰轉入五代軍事集權的典型樣本。卡面上留下的痕跡則是另一層提醒：同一個十年裡，羅馬軍團以刺突與盾守著多瑙河，東亞的騎兵則以馬槊與弓弦爭著黃河，兩套短兵與騎兵的邏輯此時分處互不往來的世界。
impactEn: The outcome of the Liang–Jin struggle had three long layers. The first was the transfer of the central plain's legitimate authority: the Later Tang took over the central plain with a Shatuo military group, and the three central plains dynasties that followed in the Five Dynasties — the Later Jin of Shi Jingtang, a Shatuo, the Later Han of Liu Zhiyuan, also a Shatuo, and the Later Zhou of Guo Wei, a man of the Xingzhou army — all came out of the same northern military and steppe background, so that the axis of Hedong, Hebei and the central plain that runs through the whole period has its source in these thirteen years. The second was the fate of Hebei. After Weibo went over to the Jin, no independent power capable of resisting the centre ever appeared again among the three circuits of Hebei; in the middle of the Five Dynasties, the reign of Shizong of the Later Zhou in the Xiande era recovered Youzhou and Yingzhou for a time, but that was only recovery, for truly to hold the sixteen prefectures of Yanyun the central plains had to wait for the short window between the end of the Later Tang and the year 936, when Shi Jingtang ceded them to the Khitan. The conquest of Yan in 923 and the return of Youzhou to the Jin handed the key of Hebei to the central dynasties, but did not solve the Khitan, who instead profited; by the time of the cession in 936 the central plains had no shield at all to the north. The third was the maturing of the art of war in these years. Cavalry movement, the grain of Hedong, control of the crossings and the use of intelligence were all pushed to their height, and the fact that the report of a single turncoat and eight days of marching decided the empire is the typical sample of the transition from the circuit wars of the late Tang to the military concentration of the Five Dynasties. What the card records in its own way is a further reminder: in the same decade the Roman legions kept the Danube with thrust and shield, while the cavalry of East Asia fought for the Yellow River with the long spear and the drawn bow, and the two logics of close combat and of riding belonged then to two worlds that had no contact with one another.
result: 打點完，後梁亡，後唐定。柏鄉之戰（910年十月至911年正月），晉軍在野河殲滅梁軍二萬餘，漳河以北只剩邢州、洺州，王鎔的成德軍自此完全倒向晉；魏州之戰（916年二月），李存勖把劉鄩的六萬梁軍包圍在故元城一帶全殲，梁廷在河北最後的機動力量被打散；夾河之陣（918年八月起）對峙一百多天，雙方各折三分之二兵力，誰也吃不下誰；到923年，十月初二渡楊劉，初四克中都、俘王彥章，初七曹州降，初九汴州下，十二日段凝的五萬主力在封丘解甲請降，梁末帝朱友貞自盡，後梁滅亡，李存勖四月的稱帝至此有了結果。梁晉爭霸以十三年的拉鋸換來八日的行軍，說明中原與河北的較量從來不是靠一次野戰定生死，而是靠河東的騎兵、河北的城，和一段足夠長的糧道。卡面那柄羅馬短劍自不曾出現在魏州與汴梁之間；它留在這張卡上，只是提醒人：同一個十年裡，羅馬軍團用刺突與盾守著多瑙河，東亞的騎兵則用馬槊與弓弦爭著黃河。
resultEn: When it was over, the Later Liang was destroyed and the Later Tang settled. At the battle of Baixiang, from the tenth month of 910 to the first of 911, the Jin destroyed more than twenty thousand Liang troops on the Yehe river, only Xingzhou and Mingzhou were left north of the Zhang River, and the Chengde Army of Wang Rong turned wholly to the Jin. At Weizhou in the second month of 916 Li Cunxu closed around the sixty thousand Liang troops of Liu Cun near the old Yuan city and destroyed them, scattering the last mobile force of the Liang in Hebei. In the Jiahe array from the eighth month of 918 the two sides faced one another for more than a hundred days and each lost two thirds of its strength, so that neither could swallow the other. Then in 923, on the second day of the tenth month the army crossed at Yangliu, on the fourth it took Zhongdu and captured Wang Yanzhang, on the seventh Cao surrendered, on the ninth Bian fell, and on the twelfth the fifty thousand men of Duan Ning laid down their arms at Fengqiu and asked to surrender, while the last Liang emperor, Zhu Youzhen, killed himself and the Later Liang ceased to exist, giving the outcome to the proclamation of the Zhuangzong in the fourth month. The Liang–Jin struggle exchanged thirteen years of seesaw for eight days of marching, which shows that the contest between the central plain and Hebei was never settled by one battle in the field, but by the cavalry of Hedong, the cities of Hebei and a supply line long enough to feed them. The gladius on the card never appeared between Weizhou and Bianliang; it remains on the card only to remind us that in the same decade the Roman legions kept the Danube with thrust and shield, while the cavalry of East Asia fought for the Yellow River with the long spear and the drawn bow.
